records.claim: Birth defects can happen in any pregnancy for different reasons. Out of all babies born each year, about 3 out of 100 (3%) will have a birth defect. We look at research studies to try to understand if an exposure, like propranolol, might increase the chance of birth defects in a pregnancy. It is not known if propranolol can increase the chance for birth defects. Studies on the use of beta-blockers in general during pregnancy have not reported an increased chance of birth defects.
